title: Business Ethics: Decisions, Stakeholders, and Accountability
learners: Business students with introductory management experience and mixed exposure to ethical theory.
coursePurpose: Use evidence and ethical frameworks to make accountable organizational recommendations under uncertainty.
outcomes: Map material stakeholders and competing obligations.
Compare recommendations under two ethical frameworks.
Defend an implementable decision with evidence, tradeoffs, and monitoring.

sourcePacket.content: A supplier audit finds unpaid overtime in one facility. The record does not establish conditions at the supplier's other facilities.
The board must choose immediate suspension, a monitored remediation period, or a phased exit; every option affects workers differently.

localConstraints: Separate known facility evidence from broader supplier inference.
Represent worker, supplier, customer, and governance consequences.
Do not present legal compliance as fully determined.
